name: io.github.SSShooter/mind-elixir-mcp
title: Mind Elixir
description: Create, edit, and organize mind maps in the Mind Elixir Desktop app from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: MIND_ELIXIR_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Target URL of the Mind Elixir Desktop MCP endpoint. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:6595/mcp

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription: A local bridge to the MCP server built into Mind Elixir Desktop. It exposes seven tools that let an AI assistant create a mind map from scratch, read the map that is currently open, rename and add nodes, attach summary nodes over a range of siblings, and draw labelled arrows between nodes. All processing stays on the user's machine: the desktop app hosts the endpoint on 127.0.0.1:6595 and the bridge only forwards JSON-RPC over loopback.

tools.name: new_mindmap
tools.description: Create a new blank mind map and navigate the app to the editor.

tools.name: get_all_nodes
tools.description: Return the full node tree (topics, IDs, hierarchy) of the current mind map.

tools.name: generate_mindmap
tools.description: Replace the current mind map with one built from a JSON structure.

tools.name: edit_topic
tools.description: Change the topic text of an existing node, keeping its position and links.

tools.name: add_child
tools.description: Add a child node under an existing parent; returns the generated node ID.

tools.name: add_node_summary
tools.description: Attach a summary node that consolidates a range of sibling child nodes.

tools.name: add_arrow
tools.description: Draw a labelled connection arrow between two nodes to show a relationship.
